messages:
izzy: heads-up — bringup for novo-8b q4_1 shows 5.3% recall regression on paraphrase_promptset_long (esp. pt/it). canary eval id eval/1761119500. float=0.901, q4_1=0.854 :grimacing:
noah: can you dump lowconf ids and run dedupe+lang stratify?
izzy: pulling from s3://redwood-evals/ingest/paraphrase_lowconf_long/*.jsonl. plan: dedupe (faiss+fingerprint), sample 2k edge cases, tag by lang then label.
ravi: label capacity: we have 1.2k human slots. label-bot can open queue for the remaining 800 via contractors. keep synth <=15%.
label-bot: queue opened labelflow://queues/paraphrase-long-gold-2026-03 items=2000 tags=pt,it,ambig
noah: run token alignment diff to rule out tokenization drift:
``npython scripts/token_diff.py --model novo-8b-float,novo-8b-q4_1 --samples 1200 --out /tmp/novo_tokdiff.json
```
izzy: also target examples where float gives correct intent but q4_1 outputs shorter paraphrase — likely KV precision loss. plan: if after gold augmentation gap >3% -> rollback qkernel; if concentrated on longctx -> per-layer fallback for last 6 layers.
eval-bot: canary started by izzy at 1761119500 — https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/1761119500
label-bot: holdout created s3://redwood-evals/curation/paraphrase_holdout_double_v1/ (300 items, double-reviewed)
noah: once gold is in place run compare and stratify by lang+length and produce per-bucket diffs. post results here.
izzy: thanks — @ravi please prioritize PT/IT, tag ambig/deid/synth. I'll post eval diffs when complete. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: canary finished at 1761120600 — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/1761120600/
